info.title: 555 PWM motor controller
info.question: How does a pulse train control motor speed?
info.expected: The 555 drives an N-channel MOSFET; armature inductance, inertia and flyback conduction smooth the motion between pulses.
info.try: Select P1 to change timer timing/duty; select MTR1 to change load and watch RPM/current. Compare motor voltage/current, gate pulses and D1 flyback current.
info.limitation: Generic brushed DC motor: armature RL, reciprocal Ke=Kt electromechanical coupling, rotor inertia, viscous friction and load. No brushes, commutation ripple, thermal model, gearbox or hardware ratings.
